posts.title: In Praise of Bureaucracy
posts.description: Good bureaucracy gives people autonomy and keeps organizations working when exceptional people leave. The challenge is knowing which rules are worth having.

posts.title: Some Projects Need to Fail
posts.description: Rescuing a failing project feels responsible, but it may hide the real problem. Sometimes the most honest thing you can do is let it fail.

posts.title: The Years We Can't Hire Back
posts.description: Examining why AI era cuts to junior engineer hiring risk too few seniors later, with lessons from the airline captain shortage and advice for CS students.
